entries.claim: COD-4 Android CI gates: fmt, actionlint, CI scenarios test, host + wasm32 clippy -D warnings, android unit tests (9/9), and boundaries (25/25)
entries.label: gates-fmt-actionlint-clippy-android-boundaries
command: set -euo pipefail; cargo fmt --all --check; actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml; python3 -m unittest scripts/test_ci_scenarios.py; cargo clippy --locked -p android -p boundaries --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p duet-app -p mobile --lib --bins -- -D warnings; cargo test --locked -p android; cargo test --locked -p boundaries

entries.claim: COD-4 real headless Android 15 emulator proof: build Duet APK using platform/android/maven-central-mirror.gradle and pass coda.duet.ModeShellTest with System UI ANR handling
entries.label: headless-android-emulator-modeshelltest
command: set -euo pipefail; cargo run --locked -p android -- test --headless coda.duet.ModeShellTest
